service.description: Registration of a construction worker on e-Nirman (BOCW board); the card is collected after verification.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card, bank passbook, passport size photo, certificate of 90 days of construction work (contractor or gram panchayat), ration card
service.rules: For construction workers aged 18–60 who did at least 90 days of construction work in the last 12 months. Give the acknowledgement to the customer.
